1947, October
The following is a faithful transcription of Retreat Notes, October 12 - 16, 1947, by the servant of God Father Solanus Casey OFM Cap. ( found in NOTEBOOK NO. 10 pages 71 to 78.
ST. FELIX RETREAT
% Fr. Marcellus .... of Pittsburgh
Oct. 12, 1947
Introd'n. Purpose of Ret. To checkup on self. - Retrogr's
Oct. 13th
C.I. Purpose of rational Creature.
- TO KNOW GOD, - primary and all including. To love and to serve God follows (or follow), logically of itself. PURPOSE? "TO SAVE MY SOUL."
C. II. Why a religious? REPARATION.
- for personal sins - for throughless - conversion of sinners - for the suffering, holy Souls in P. to supply what is want- ing in the bitter Passion of Jesus Christ.
C. III. THE HOLY PRIESTHOOD - magnitude and preeminence of dignity, powers, et
b) THE LAY-BROTHER - Assistent.
C.IV. HUMILITY. VIRTUES"S FOUNDATION.
Soul of Christian virtues from A-Z. Practical MOTTO_ADMONITION of three words: "I-AM - THIRD ... God - My Neighbor - myself. Famous actor - singer - speaker ... finally ordained, prepares with great effort to "show students and brethren (in Mt. S. Pul. - Wash. ) how to preach. Everything went fine till middle of sermon when memory failed." .... Had you gone up (into pulpit), you would have come down in a way, as you went up." A well- meaning religious after all, he profited by the humiliation, a practical lesson.
Oct. 14th - '47 - Tuesday
C.I. THE VOWS, particularly POVERTY
Vow of chastity really included in that of poverty, viz, the right and privilege to have wife & Fam.
